<infobox theme="Plant">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Biological classification</header>
        <data source="designation"><label>Designation</label></data>
        <data source="class"><label>Classification</label></data>
        <data source="origin"><label>Place of origin</label></data>
        <data source="found"><label>Found on</label></data>
        <data source="habitat"><label>Habitat</label></data>
        <data source="lifespan"><label>Lifespan</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Specifications</header>
        <data source="description"><label>Physical description</label></data>
        <data source="edible"><label>Edible by</label></data>
        <data source="inedible"><label>Inedible by or toxic to</label></data>
        <data source="nutrition"><label>Other nutritional info</label></data>
        <data source="effects"><label>Effects</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Other information</header>
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Plant|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
